sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Mangrove Swamp and Swamp.

sections.heading: Description
lines: Swamp Field is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Telluric field and can be found in Honec Woods.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: This field can be generated while another field is active. The original field's effects are suppressed while Swamp Field is active. Once Swamp Field expires, the original field returns.
Swamp Field cannot be generated while Frozen Dimensional Field or Underwater Field is active.

This field is generated if the moves Grass Pledge and Water Pledge are used one after the other in a battle (any number of turns apart, as long as the active field is not changed in those turns). The field lasts for 4 turns normally and 7 turns if the user of the second move holds an Amplifield Rock. If either move is used again while the field is active, the duration of the field will be refreshed.
“The pledges combined and formed a swamp!”
“The pledges combined and reinforced the swamp!”
Grassy Terrain and Forest Field will transform into this field if Surf is used 3 times or Muddy Water is used 2 times.
“The grassy terrain became marshy!”
“The forest became marshy!”
Specifically, using Surf increments the counter by +1 and using Muddy Water increments it by +2. The field changes to Swamp Field when the counter reaches 3.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Bug, Grass, Water-type moves → 1.3x boost.
“Bugs are swarming everywhere!”
“Thick mangroves line the area!”
“The dampness strengthened the attack!”
Fire-type moves → 0.8x decrease.
“The dampness weakened the flame...”
Grounded Pokémon have their Speed reduced by 1 stage at the end of the turn.
“[Pokémon]'s Speed sank...!”
Pokémon under the effect of a trapping move have their Speed lowered by 2 stages instead.
Pokémon are immune to this effect if they hold Heavy-Duty Boots or a Clear Amulet, or have the abilities Clear Body, Propeller Tail, Quick Feet, Swift Swim or White Smoke.
As of V14.0.22, Clear Body and White Smoke aren't listed in the in-game Field Notes.
Sleeping Pokémon lose 1/16 of their max HP each turn.
“[Pokémon]'s strength is sapped by the swamp!”
Pokémon under the effect of a trapping move lose 1/8 of their max HP instead.
Draining HP from a Pokémon, including with Strength Sap, randomly lowers one of its stats.
This does not include the item Shell Bell.
Leech Seed only lowers its target's stat at the end of each turn, and only when restoring HP.

sections.heading: Abilities Affected
lines: Buffed Abilities:
Dry Skin recovers 1/16 of the user's max HP at the end of each turn.
“[Pokémon]'s Dry Skin was healed by the murk!”
Foam Spray lowers Defense by 2 stages on activation.
Gooey lowers Speed by 2 stages on activation.
Rattled raises the user's Speed by 1 stage on switch-in.
Water Compaction is activated at the end of each turn if the user is grounded.
Other Ability Changes:
Gulp Missile will always pick up a Arrokuda.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage Modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:
Smack Down, Thousand Arrows → 1.5x boost, Water sub-typing.
“The murk strengthened the attack!”
Brine, Gunk Shot, Hydro Vortex, Mud Barrage, Mud Bomb, Mud Shot, Mud Slap, Muddy Water, Savage Spin-Out, Sludge Wave → 1.5x boost.
“The murk strengthened the attack!”
“There are bugs EVERYWHERE!”
Moves which receive an attack nerf:
Bulldoze, Earthquake, Magnitude → 0.25x decrease.
“The attack dissipated in the soggy ground...”
Explosion, Mind Blown, Self-Destruct → Fail on use.
“The dampness prevents the explosion!”
Other moves: Buffed Moves:
Aqua Ring restores 1/8 max HP each turn instead of 1/16.
Attack Order and String Shot randomly lower one of the target's stats by 1 stage.
Infestation, Snap Trap and Spider Web randomly lower one of the target's stats by 1 stage at the end of each turn they're active.
Mud Shot lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.
Poison Powder, Sleep Powder and Stun Spore's accuracy is increased to 100%.
Roar displays a different message. There is no other additional effect.
“What are ya doin' in my swamp?!”
Shelter raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.
Struggle Bug lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.
Field-dependent moves & Abilities:
Mimicry changes the user's type to Water.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Water.
Nature Power becomes Muddy Water.
Secret Power may lower Speed by 1 stage.
Shelter halves damage from Water-type moves.
Terrain Pulse becomes Water-type.

sections.heading: Items
lines: Telluric Seed raises the user's Defense by 1 stage and changes their ability to Clear Body.
“[Pokémon]'s body became clear!”

sections.heading: Other Notes
lines: Prior to V14, Steam Engine protected the user from the field's Speed drop.
